subject: Future Tech
title: Fighting Cancer with Edited Cells
description: A quick win: understand Fighting Cancer with Edited Cells.

hook.text: CAR-T therapy takes a patient's immune cells, edits them to recognize cancer, and infuses them back to hunt tumors.

buildup.text: CRISPR supercharges CAR-T by disabling checkpoints that cancer uses to hide from the immune system.

discovery.text: In early trials, CRISPR-edited CAR-T cells shrank tumors in patients who had failed every other treatment.

twist.text: CAR-T works best for blood cancers.

climax.text: Next-generation edits aim to make universal donor cells, ending the costly need to customize therapy for each patient.

punchline.text: Edited immune cells are search-and-destroy missiles for cancer.

quiz.question: What does CRISPR add to CAR-T cancer therapy?
options: Removes checkpoints cancer uses to hide
